results.title: Olivia Attwood Speaks Out on 'Sham' Marriage to Bradley Dack and Relationship with Pete Wicks
results.description: TV personality Olivia Attwood has opened up about her split from ex-husband Bradley Dack, accusing him of cheating on her multiple times over ten years. She also spoke about her relationship with new boyfriend Pete Wicks and confirmed that her relationship with ITV is still strong.

results.title: The Last House: A Messy Thriller Fails to Deliver on Its Promise
results.description: The Last House is a Netflix film directed by Louis Leterrier, which follows a family trapped inside their house due to an unexplained seal on the doors and windows. The movie is criticized for its mishandling of the premise and weak character development.

results.title: Heartbreak at reason mom of 4 has ultrasound of twins on fridge
results.description: DeAnna Boughman told Newsweek the ultrasound served as a reminder of the joy and blessings that came before everything changed.
